fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied no street address (Indeed locations list) and city-centroid coords (37.3565, -77.4317) for Chester VA, ~7km off. Resolved to 16000 Walthall Industrial Pkwy, South Chesterfield VA 23834 - the documented DSC Logistics / CJ Logistics America Richmond-area facility (the Manta/Yellowpages/D&B listings give cjlogistics.com as the company site). DSC Logistics is CJ Logistics America's legacy brand. Geocoded ROOFTOP to 37.2983, -77.3998; satellite confirmed a large multi-section cross-dock DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The facility is reached by a winding access road through woods from Walthall Industrial Pkwy. At the building, the truck driveway runs into the truck court as an open approach - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth observed on the truck route (z19-z21 satellite; only utility transformers near the entry). truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at the building entrance or truck court.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long multi-section warehouse (~6 connected gabled sections, ~700ft) with trailers backed into dock doors along BOTH long faces (SW and NE) - cross-dock. ~60 doors estimated (50+ band). Approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers visible at docks along both faces; no clearly dedicated separate trailer-storage lot - most trailers are backed into docks. dropArea 10-25, dropYard=false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on opposing building faces (SW and NE) form physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long winding access road from Walthall Industrial Pkwy plus a deep truck court -> holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NW-SE just NE of the building beyond a drainage ditch, but it is a through line - no spur enters the property. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits in a wooded edge-of-town industrial area off Walthall Industrial Pkwy in South Chesterfield, scattered rural residential and woodland around it -> Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is somewhat isolated in woods but an industrial park is adjacent - cellular coverage likely adequate; left false (low confidence).
